t: Years after their original inception, magical botanists have finally found a new material able to harness the powers of $(aura) through new means: the mystical and elusive $(item)Netherite$(). With it, one can create a most powerful material: $(item)Ingots of the Depths$(). These ingots, as expected, can also be turned into $(l:items/depth_armor)armor$() and $(l:items/depth_tools)tools$().
在最初的构想问世多年之后，魔法植物学家终于找到了一种能以全新方式驾驭$(aura-zh-cn)之力的材料——神秘而难觅的$(item)下界合金$()。用它可以炼出一种极其强大的材料：$(item)深渊锭$()。不出所料，这种锭同样能做成$(l:items/depth_armor)盔甲$()与$(l:items/depth_tools)工具$()。
